term: global and restricted finite-observation proof denial
definition: GlobalNoEmpiricalProof denies finite-observation conclusive verifiability at every inquiry. RestrictedNoEmpiricalProof denies it only on an independently specified scope. ScopedObservationBarrier is the explicit consequential input T→ObservationBarrier; domain classification alone does not supply it.
